response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS av FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count_above, AVG(c.cnt - a.av) AS avg_excess FROM c, a WHERE c.cnt > a.av
